evidence.observation: Early growth pressure was 3.045 Torr with Ar 99.5 sccm and temperature 752.0 °C.
Pressure increased to 3.134 Torr despite stable Ar at 99.9 sccm and temperature at 750.1 °C.
Pressure continued rising to 3.265 Torr with Ar 101.3 sccm and temperature 750.1 °C.
Pressure reached 3.338 Torr, about 10% above early growth, while Ar was 99.1 sccm and temperature 749.5 °C; the sustained pressure rise is not explained by the setpoints.
Exhaust oxygen sensor is not installed, so null O2 readings provide no evidence about air ingress.

args.missing_evidence: Independent pressure verification and leak/exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish leakage, exhaust restriction, or a measurement fault; sample characterization is not yet available.
